reemerge.line: And when she looks at me with your eyes, the shape of almonds, I am stirred ins…
stanza: Every day that comes, the echo of you living here gets quieter
Obscured by the loud wind of us now wailing and moaning for you
But also living, talking about school, making food, or just surviving and still…
Waking up again, the baby that you knew is now a kid
And when she looks at me with your eyes, the shape of almonds, I am stirred ins…

urge.line: When you started walking I fight back the urge
stanza: Three in the morning I lay my hand over
Your heart just to know you were safe in your sleep
When you started walking I fight back the urge
To stay right there beside you, keep you on your feet

urge.line: I don't think I'll feel the urge
stanza: I don't think I'll feel the urge
I won't even feel an urge
